summary.text: Jay Reedy is a Republican state representative from Tennessee House District 74 who has served since November 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jay Reedy assumed office representing Tennessee House District 74 on November 4, 2014.
Ballotpedia lists him on the Agriculture and Natural Resources and Local Government committees and as vice chair of the Government Operations Committee for the 2023-2024 session.

Ballotpedia also reports that he ran for the Republican nomination in Tennessee's 7th Congressional District but did not appear on the ballot for the August 6, 2026 primary, while advancing from the Republican primary for his House seat.
